title: Training job silently stalls: one rank hangs, others spin at 100% 'utilisation' with no progress

expected.reason: Step counter stops for 21 minutes while the scheduler still says running. 15 GPUs show 100% util (a busy-wait inside the collective, not real work) at ~40% power. Wastes ~$18/hour of compute and the deadline slips.

context.note: No checkpoint is due (last at step 41500, next 42000) and no storage writes. Compare with B01, which looks similar for ~90s but is a checkpoint.

glossary.rank: One process in a distributed job, usually one per GPU.
glossary.spin-wait: GPU kernel busy-polling for data from another GPU; counts as 'utilised' but does no useful work.
